content.value_statement: International expansion can expose sellers to tax, logistics, payment, and localization risks. This skill compares markets, fulfillment models, compliance duties, and rollout phases in one planning workflow.
actual_capabilities: Scores target markets across eight weighted dimensions.
Compares direct shipping, 3PL, marketplace fulfillment, dropshipping, and consolidation.
Summarizes tax, VAT, GST, duty, and customs considerations for key markets.
Maps local payment preferences and currency strategy by country.
Builds phased expansion roadmaps with milestones, KPIs, and budget estimates.
Provides a landed cost framework with margin impact analysis.
limitations: It does not provide legal, tax, or customs advice.
Shipping and duty estimates require current quotes and product data.
Market data may become outdated as regulations and tariffs change.
It does not connect to stores or marketplaces without separate tools.

use_cases.title: Choose First Expansion Markets
use_cases.description: Compare countries by market size, competition, logistics, payments, and compliance before committing budget.

use_cases.title: Plan Marketplace Fulfillment
use_cases.description: Evaluate FBA, local 3PL, direct shipping, and consolidation options for international marketplace sales.

use_cases.title: Estimate Launch Economics
use_cases.description: Build landed cost, margin, payment, tax, and milestone assumptions for a phased market launch.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Expansion Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for one seller profile.
prompt_templates.prompt: I sell [product] on [platform] in [current market] at [monthly revenue]. Assess whether I am ready for international expansion.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Target Markets
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [country 1], [country 2], and [country 3] for my [product category]. Score each market and recommend the best launch order.

prompt_templates.title: Design Fulfillment And Compliance
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a fulfillment, tax, duty, payment, and localization plan for selling [product] from [origin country] into [target country].

prompt_templates.title: Build A Full Expansion Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 12-month cross-border expansion roadmap for [brand]. Include market scorecards, landed costs, risks, KPIs, budget, and weekly next steps.

output_examples.input: A US Shopify pet brand wants to evaluate Canada, the UK, and Germany.
output_examples.output: The skill returns ranked market scorecards, compliance notes, fulfillment options, payment requirements, and a phased launch plan.

output_examples.input: An Amazon kitchenware seller wants to understand EU VAT and fulfillment choices.
output_examples.output: The skill outlines VAT registration triggers, IOSS considerations, FBA and 3PL tradeoffs, landed cost drivers, and launch milestones.

output_examples.input: An Etsy jewelry shop receives international orders but loses margin on shipping.
output_examples.output: The skill analyzes shipping costs, returns, duties, pricing buffers, local payment expectations, and practical margin recovery steps.

best_practices: Provide product dimensions, origin country, sales channel, price, and target markets.
Use the market scorecard before selecting fulfillment and tax workflows.
Verify all tax, customs, and certification steps with qualified local advisors.
anti_patterns: Do not treat benchmark costs as final quotes.
Do not launch before checking duties, VAT, GST, and product certification requirements.
Do not copy domestic pricing without landed cost and currency analysis.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal or tax advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning guidance and checklists. Confirm filings, rates, and obligations with qualified advisors.

faq.question: Which markets does it cover?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for major markets such as the EU, UK, US, Canada, Australia, Japan, and other common regions.

faq.question: Can it compare fulfillment models?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares direct shipping, 3PL, marketplace fulfillment, dropshipping, and consolidation models.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: No. The skill works from user-provided business details and built-in planning frameworks.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide your product, platform, origin market, current revenue, target countries, price, size, weight, and budget.
